reason: My regulars and Google reviews bring my customers, and I've never needed creators. Some beta app from a small team asking me to sign in with Google, teach my counter staff a PIN, and chase ₹200 a month is just more hassle, and I don't know who you are.
objection: Who are you? A new startup could disappear in three months and leave my staff confused, and I don't want strangers making videos of my shop.
would_change_my_mind: Another café owner I know nearby telling me it actually brought them new paying customers, or my nephew setting it up and handling it for me.
